resources.string: Open a Settings page X times, Y ms apart
Times (X) — how many times to open it
Random page each time (ignores the page above)
Use root (su) — open pages from a root shell, works in the background

The first page opens straight away; the rest follow Y ms apart. Stop cancels whatever is left. If the page is already on screen, opening it again just brings it to the front — the count still advances. Press Back to come back here and see the final count.
